input.goal: Build a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo: index.html + scene.js + engine3d.js + app.js, with a software 3D renderer (Canvas 2D, no WebGL, no external libraries) on a full-viewport <canvas id="c">.
constraints: Files: index.html loads engine3d.js, scene.js, app.js via plain <script> tags in that order (no modules, no CDN, works from file://).

engine3d.js: software 3D renderer: vec3 math, perspective projection, camera lookAt, back-face culling, painter's algorithm depth sort of triangles/quads, flat shading with a directional light plus emissive neon colors drawn via ctx 2D paths.
Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> resized to window.innerWidth x innerHeight (devicePixelRatio aware), body margin 0, overflow hidden.
Background each frame: dark radial-gradient space, center #1a0b2e fading to edge #05010a.
Scene: a two-tier platform (lower wide box + upper narrower box), twin pillars, a lintel across the pillar tops, and a crown cap on top of the lintel: exactly 6 boxes x 6 faces = 36 box faces.
Six octahedral crystals (8 triangles each = 48 triangles) orbiting the portal, each spinning, colors cycling cyan #00f0ff, magenta #ff2bd6, violet #9d4bff.

Portal core between the pillars: a glowing disc/core (radial gradient, additive 'lighter' blending) with two concentric rings rotating in opposite directions (outer ring cyan #00f0ff, inner ring magenta #ff2bd6), drawn with neon glow (shadowBlur).
Cyber grid floor: neon lines on a ground plane (color #00f0ff with fading alpha toward distance), projected in 3D.
Exactly 180 stars with individual twinkle (sinusoidal alpha with random phase).
Exactly 110 rising particles that float upward from the platform area and respawn at the bottom when they exceed a max height.
Orbiting camera: circles the portal at fixed radius with slight bobbing height, always looking at the portal center; orbit can be toggled off.
Glassmorphism HUD panel at top-left: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.2), border-radius 14px, text color #e8f7ff, font system-ui.
HUD title text exactly 'NEON PORTAL 3D'.
HUD stats with ids: #fps showing 'FPS: <n>', #polys showing 'POLYS: <n>' (polygons drawn last frame), #parts showing 'PARTS: <n>' (110).

Buttons with ids and initial labels: #pause 'Pause' (toggles to 'Resume' and back), #orbit 'Orbit ON' (toggles to 'Orbit OFF' and back), #reset 'Reset' (resets time, camera angle, speed to 1, orbit ON, unpaused).
Speed slider <input type="range" id="speed" min="0" max="3" step="0.1" value="1"> controlling animation speed multiplier.

Expose window.app = { paused: bool, orbit: bool, speed: number, time: number, camAngle: number, stars: array, particles: array, crystals: array, boxFaces: number (36), crystalTris: number (48), polys: number }. time and camAngle advance only when not paused (camAngle only when orbit on), scaled by speed.
Animation via requestAnimationFrame; no console errors.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#c"},{"text":"body","match":"NEON PORTAL 3D"},{"exists":"#pause"},{"exists":"#orbit"},{"exists":"#reset"},{"exists":"#speed"},{"wait":800},{"expect":"moving"},{"js":"app.stars.length===180 && app.particles.length===110 && app.crystals.length===6 && app.boxFaces===36 && app.crystalTris===48"},{"js":"app.polys>0 && /FPS/.test(document.getElementById('fps').textContent) && /POLYS/.test(document.getElementById('polys').textContent) && /PARTS: 110/.test(document.getElementById('parts').textContent)"},{"click":"#pause"},{"js":"app.paused===true && document.getElementById('pause').textContent.trim()==='Resume'"},{"click":"#orbit"},{"js":"app.orbit===false && document.getElementById('orbit').textContent.trim()==='Orbit OFF'"},{"js":"(()=>{const s=document.getElementById('speed');s.value='2';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return app.speed===2})()"},{"click":"#reset"},{"js":"app.paused===false && app.orbit===true && app.speed===1 && document.getElementById('orbit').textContent.trim()==='Orbit ON' && document.getElementById('pause').textContent.trim()==='Pause'"}]}
